svg.font-family: 'Visual Anything Roboto', system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Order process
svg.desc:
How the shop handles an order, lane by lane, and the messages it exchanges with the customer.
Its long description, an outline of every shape and relation, is in “Online order - Order process.md”.

rdf:Description.dc:creator: Visual Anything
